author: eliza
source: his 2026-10-26 08:11: "yeah let's get 26a running", after my plan of two builds (silent first, then the radio), and 08:14 "yup"
_note: BOARD SPACE TEST BS1: missionboard26a (Jessica's) WITHOUT ITS SPEECH, on the new boardspace template (his MB01a whole: its orbit pick,
its scripts, its map marker on the accept). Her prose, object and objective verbatim; the speaker, broadcast, say and message are left out
because the template builds none yet, and her recipe keeps them for build two.
Reading it: taken from the board, the system objective shows, arriving in the system swaps to the repair objective, using the satellite pays.
Any fault is a board or orbit fault, not a speech one. Unbuilt once 26a builds.

place._altitude: MB01e's (2026-10-26 08:5x). The marker alone did not fill (08:53 session: 66 'failed to fill aliases'); the orbit still carried MB01a's 20.589, and MB01a is the one MB01 that fails. With this, BS1's alias set is MB01e's whole; a failure after it is in what the build changed, not the set.

prose.name: Repairs: Navigation Satellite over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A navigation satellite over <Planet> has stopped broadcasting, and ships coming in have been flying the approach blind.
prose.card: Repair contract. A navigation satellite in orbit over <Planet> has stopped broadcasting. Fly out to it and bring it back online. Payment on contract completion.

beats._at: MB01e's marker (2026-10-26 08:5x). BS1 first kept MB01a's own, se_TravelMarkerLocRefB02, and never filled (StoryManager.0.log: failed to fill aliases, every refresh); his MB01a fails the same way in that log and the one before, while MB01b and MB01e pass, and the three differ only in this ref type and the orbit's altitude. A difference, not a proven cause: this rung tests it.
beats.journal: The navigation satellite over <Planet> had stopped broadcasting. I flew out to it and got it working again.
beats.name: Navigation Satellite
say: There it is. It's broadcasting again. Every approach just got a lot less exciting. Thank you.
beats._say: Jessica's 26a closing line, verbatim (rung 2, his "go" 2026-10-26 09:24). Her beat message is not carried: the activator's script shows its own.

speaker.name: Approach Control
speaker._recast: Roger, 2026-10-26, his "yeah put rodger in": Katie X (MzqUf1HbJ8UmQ0wUsx2p) was ruled out by his ear ("a bit stilted and robotic", voices.md). Roger is the one Delve voice he has confirmed in game (Relay Control, 09a).

broadcast: You're out at the satellite? Good. It went silent three days ago, and pilots have been landing on guesswork ever since. Whatever's wrong is on the satellite itself. Nothing we send from down here gets through.
_speech: Jessica's 26a speaker and broadcast, verbatim. The broadcast plays within 1500 m of the satellite (the template's arrival).
